testimonials.name: Nagaraju chowdary
testimonials.quote: Zoho Books helped me to manage the complete accounting process, including customer invoicing, purchase entries, vendor payments, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, GST compliance, and financial reports. Daily transactions are recorded in the system, and the data automatically reflects in receivables, payables, profit & loss, balance sheet, and GST reports, providing real-time visibility of the business finances.

testimonials.name: Kunal
testimonials.quote: Zoho Books has taken the guesswork out of our daily finances. Having live visibility into our receivables, stock, and GST compliance from anywhere—while staying effortlessly synced with our accountant—has been a game changer for our business.

testimonials.name: S. Janaki Ram
testimonials.quote: We are extremely pleased with the bookkeeping and accounting services provided by Cornerstone. Their professionalism, commitment, accuracy, and timely support in maintaining our financial records have been commendable.

testimonials.name: Nishant
testimonials.quote: Switching from Tally ERP to Zoho Books has been a great experience. The improved features, user-friendly interface and seamless accounting make business management easier and more efficient.

testimonials.name: Boya Ravi Kumar
testimonials.quote: Good communication and improving our business quickly.
